title: Enterprise Support: Official incident registration
content:
Enterprise Support — Official incident registration.

## Policy clauses

Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration in hours and availability percentage from the official operational report.

No customer statement substitutes for the report.

Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though outage credit accounting excludes them.

Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.
